definition: Data Governance Basics is a core concept in Data Analytics. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Data Governance Basics is
theory.body: Data Governance Basics describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Data Governance Basics is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Data Governance Basics matters
theory.body: Without Data Governance Basics, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Data Governance Basics works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Data Governance Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Data Governance Basics.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Data Governance Basics
theory.body: Data Governance Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
